030package dev.visdb.seesaw.decorators;
031
032import java.lang.System.Logger;
033import java.util.EnumMap;
034import java.util.Map;
035
036import javax.swing.text.AttributeSet;
037
038import dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.JStuff;
039import dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.SsComponent;
040
041import static dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.JStuff.sf;
042import static java.lang.System.Logger.Level.DEBUG;
043
044/**
045 * This TextDecorator applies a named TextStyle based on ComponentState.
046 * There is a map of ComponentState to text style name.
047 * If no style name is available for a ComponentState, {@link TextStyles#RESET}
048 * is used.
049 */
050public class ComponentStateTextDecorator extends BaseTextDecorator {
051  private static final Logger logger = JStuff.getLogger();
052
053  private final EnumMap<ComponentState, String> styleNames = new EnumMap<>(ComponentState.class);
054
055  /**
056   * Create using specified map.
057   * @param map
058   */
059  public ComponentStateTextDecorator(Map<ComponentState, String> map) {
060    styleNames.putAll(map);
061  }
062
063  /**
064   * Decorate the text according to {@code valid}.
065   * @param valid
066   */
067  public void decorateText(SsComponent.ValidationResult valid) {
068    ComponentState state = ComponentState.getComponentState(getSsComponent(), valid);
069    AttributeSet style = TextStyles.getStyle(styleNames.get(state));
070    TextStyles.applyStyle(jComp(), style != null ? style : TextStyles.RESET);
071    logger.log(DEBUG, sf("Style: %s", jComp().getClientProperty(TextStyles.STYLE_NAME)));
072  }
073
074  /**
075   * Validate the component and decorate the text accordingly.
076   */
077  @Override
078  public void decorateText() {
079    SsComponent.ValidationResult valid = getSsComponent().allValidate();
080    decorateText(valid);
081  }
082}
